pr:565.body:
**Based on `main` at `ba6582dd`.** Everything this surface was stacked on — the welcome page, the subagent line, the artifact panel (#549–#562) — has merged, so this pull request now carries a single commit (`5037ae4e`) and the diff below is the settings change alone.

设置 had a footer with 取消并关闭 / 保存 / 保存并关闭 whose middle button could not be used on most pages: 模型, 技能, MCP 服务器, 专家 and 网络 already saved inside their own cards, 通用 saved the moment a control was pressed, and only 超时 staged a draft. The footer therefore offered a commit button for one page and a misleading affordance on the rest — and on 超时 a user who pressed 取消并关闭 lost the draft with no way to tell that was about to happen.

This change removes the footer and gives the pages that had no way to change what they show one.

## Every page writes on the press, and the footer is gone

`SettingsSaveContext`, `save.ts`, the footer markup and its CSS are deleted. `SystemSettingsDialog` now only owns the directory, the pane and the Escape handling; the pane renders straight into the detail column.

超时, the one page that staged a draft, commits itself: a switch the moment it flips, a number when the field is left or Enter is pressed. The write is a whole-object `PUT`, so edits that arrive while one is in flight are coalesced into the latest draft rather than racing each other, and a refused write puts the fields back to what the server still has and shows why. An emptied number box is treated as a field mid-edit instead of `0` — `0` means 不限, and `Number("") === 0` would silently disable a timeout as the user cleared the field to retype it. A status line under the rows reports 保存中… / 已保存 · <time>, and a failure both reverts and states the reason.

## 模型 can find, rename and remove a profile

Three gaps in the model page are closed:

- **Delete.** `DELETE /api/models/:id`, behind a confirmation that names the profile. The service refuses while a project or session still names it; that refusal is shown instead of being swallowed.
- **Rename.** `PUT /api/models/:id` is a whole-record write, not a patch: an omitted field takes its default rather than its stored value, so an absent `vision` would turn vision off. The request therefore sends back every field whose default differs from what is stored, and leaves `facts`, the token and the proxy policy out on purpose so each keeps its stored value. The service locks `baseUrl` and the protocol to the provider, so a provider model can change which model it calls but not where it calls it.
- **Pick from the provider's list.** `GET /api/providers/:id/models` (with `refresh=1` to bypass the server's short-lived cache) lets a model be chosen from what the vendor actually reports. A model another entry already uses appears as 已添加 and cannot be picked twice, which is the reason the picker is a listbox the app draws (`ModelSelect`) rather than a native `<select>`: an OS-drawn popup can grey a row out but cannot say why. The list is portalled to the body and fixed to the trigger's rectangle, since the settings pane scrolls and a menu positioned inside it would be clipped.

## 技能 can be written in the app

新增技能 opens a form for name, description, instructions, license, version and compatibility; the server turns the fields into `SKILL.md` and installs the first revision (`POST /api/skills`). The name is checked locally against the same rule the server applies — lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens — so a bad id is caught before a round trip.

## MCP servers read as one list

The custom and built-in halves were two differently shaped sections on one page. They are now a single list where each row states its transport, tools and switch, and editing moved out of an inline expansion into a modal. The page carries one note explaining that the switch only controls the server itself — which data sources a session may use is still the session's decision.

## A specialist's capabilities are chosen, not scrolled

编辑专家 now exists, and capabilities are picked through 添加技能 / 添加连接器 dialogs (`AbilityPicker`) instead of two long checkbox lists. A 完全访问 switch is separate from the item pickers, because "the whole set, including whatever is added later" and "these six items" are different promises and a checkbox list cannot express the first.

## 界面语言 stops being a native select

通用's 界面语言 was the last control on the surface whose popup the browser drew itself: an OS list in the system's type and colours, inside a page where every other control belongs to the app. It now uses the same portalled listbox as the model picker, without the caption the row already carries. The Chinese option is named `简体中文` in both languages — a language names itself, and "Simplified Chinese" asks someone on an English page to read English before they can find their own.

## Supporting pieces

`SettingsModal` is the shell every settings form opens in. Its stack of open dialogs is what makes one Escape close one dialog: the settings surface listens on `window` and would otherwise close together with the modal, and with a picker open over the specialist form both listeners sit on the same node, so `preventDefault` alone arrives too late. Escape belongs to the topmost settings dialog and nothing else.

`ListSelect` is the listbox both 界面语言 and the model field use: a trigger plus a menu portalled to the body and fixed to the trigger's rectangle, because the settings pane scrolls and a menu drawn inside it would be clipped at the pane's edge.

`app/use-workspace.ts` gets one guard: with no stored credential the app is showing the gate, so the boot health check is not fired. Health is public, but everything behind it is not, and firing it only to be refused turns "paste your token" into "the token was rejected" on a first visit.

## Validation

`apps/desktop`, the package this change touches:

- `pnpm run typecheck` clean.
- `pnpm test`: 409 tests / 409 pass / 0 fail / 0 skipped across 37 suites (the count includes the tests #562 merged).
- `pnpm run build` succeeds.

Repo layers, run locally with `CI_RESULTS_DIR=.tmp/ci-results CI_RUNTIME_DIR=.tmp/ci-runtime`, all on this head (`5037ae4e`). The same layers also run on `5037ae4e` in this pull request's own Actions run, and those are the authoritative results for this head. Every failure below is outside this diff — `git diff --stat main...HEAD -- . ':!apps/desktop'` is empty, so the failing files belong to packages this branch does not touch:

- **UT** on `5037ae4e`: planned 5008 / executed 5008 / passed 5006 / failed 2 / skipped 0. The two failures are the same two files that failed on the pre-rebase head: `services/runner/src/sandbox-network.test.ts` ("a real sandbox reaches allowed domains through the gateway and nothing else", `bwrap: Unknown option --disable-userns` — this host's bubblewrap does not accept the flag) and `services/api/src/agent-run/jiuwenswarm-agent.test.ts` (event order: `context.captured` and `state.committed` missing). An earlier run also failed `scripts/race-contract.test.mjs` (`spawnSync bash ETIMEDOUT`) and `services/api/src/server.test.ts` (timeout returned `undefined`); those passed here, which is further evidence that the layer is load-sensitive on this host rather than reporting a regression.
- **ST** on `5037ae4e`: planned 24 / executed 24 / passed 22 / failed 2 (the two counting the failing case and its file). `test/api/evolve-distribution.test.ts` fails downloading `cpython-3.12.13+20260805-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-install_only_stripped.tar.gz` from `github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone`: `fetch failed`. This host cannot reach `github.com` over TLS at the moment (pushing this branch needed a local CONNECT proxy), so the download is an environment failure, not a product one.
- **E2E** (mocked browser subset) on `5037ae4e`: **BLOCKED on this host, not a pass and not a product failure.** Planned 120 / executed 0: every shard stopped at stack startup (`BLOCKED: isolated E2E stack did not become healthy`), and the stack log says `Evolve could not start. Check the provisioned source runtime.` — the isolated runtime never came up, so no journey ran. The same five mocked shards all pass on GitHub's own runners in this pull request's run `40527927924`, which is the authoritative E2E result for this head.

A baseline of the same layers on unmodified `main` (`65eddde1`, detached worktree) could not be produced on this host: its preparation needs PyPI, and `pypi.org` is as unreachable from here as `github.com`, so it never got past `uv sync` and was stopped. The evidence that these failures are environmental rather than caused by this branch is therefore two things, stated as such: the diff touches no file in any of the failing packages, and `main` at the same commit passed UT, ST and all four L2 E2E jobs on GitHub's own runners (run 40260105695, a push to `main`).

## E2E user journeys

Coverage gap, reported as such rather than as a pass: the repository's E2E layers drive the **web** front end (`apps/web`) through Playwright; `apps/desktop` has no Playwright harness and no spec in `test/` opens its settings surface, so **this change has no automated journey**. The numbers above are the web suite's, run because they are a required layer, not as evidence about 设置.

The journeys this change would need — 通用 switching language and the page re-rendering in it; 超时 writing on blur and reporting 已保存; 模型 deleting a profile behind the confirmation — have to be added together with a desktop harness, in a separate change.

## Release

Release category: `release:feature`
User impact: the settings surface loses its footer; 超时 saves as fields are left; 模型 can delete, rename and pick from the provider's list; 技能 can be created; MCP servers and specialists are edited in modals and their capabilities picked from dialogs.
Compatibility and migration: none — no configuration key or API changes shape. Deleted test ids: the `system-config-footer` block and `views/settings/system/save.ts`, both of which only the desktop app used.

The `release:feature` GitHub label could not be applied: this account is an outside contributor without write access to the repository, so `AddLabelsToLabelable` is refused. A maintainer needs to add it; the category above is the one it should get.

pr:584.body:
The desktop chat surface is being redrawn against the Pixso handoff, and this
pull request is the transcript half of it. A question that carried files now
shows them under the question instead of losing them behind a toast; a run's
turns are one stream rather than a stack of headings; a tool call's output is
read where the card already is, and its full text opens in the right panel; and
专家 becomes a catalog the conversation is actually bound to. Three smaller
changes ride along on the same surfaces: 添加模型's key field stops reading as
a different kind of control from its neighbours, a skill's card stops
contradicting what a skill is, and 数据分析's topic row keeps to the laboratory
topics.

Nine fixes sit on top of that work. The right panel's mode now belongs to the
panel being open, so closing it and opening it again lands on 产物 / 工作区
rather than on whatever record happened to be showing; a Project name is unique
and a duplicate is refused in the form that asked for it; a new Project starts
with every skill on; 技能, MCP 服务器 and 专家 each gained 一键启用 / 一键关闭;
the composer's `/` opens the skill palette; the two 新增 entry points that only
duplicated 设置's own forms are gone; and a first install seeds one finished
Session, so the transcript, the tool blocks, the workspace and the 产物 tab all
have real content to read.

The service gains one boot-time behaviour and one refusal — a `409` on a
duplicate Project name — and no endpoint; the shape of a session does not
change.

This branch was stacked on #565, which rebuilds every 设置 page around writing
on the press and itself carries #562's artifact panel and #552's recent
sessions. That stack (#549, #550, #552, #562, #565, oldest first) merged on
2026-10-27, and this branch is rebased onto the `main` it left, so it now
carries only its own sixteen commits: `20b730a7` (uploads under the question),
`fdef4cfd` (one stream, the tool panel, the 专家 catalog), `80e15b07` (the API
key field's face), `5c3de8a4` (what a skill's card says), `4c33127f` (数据分析's
topic row), `e1a31af7` (the sample Session), `abd92764` (a Project's name and
its skills), `8dadbe46` (the nine desktop fixes), `e0288139` (the configuration
reference for the new flag), `d15f61c3` (the sample's own name and its
artifacts), `10329d3c` (a shared skill mark, the bulk control), `26473ca0` (the
panel's default group, the Session heading), `c353b728` (the three-step first
run), `28d3e71f` (the MCP page no longer describes adding a server), `2df0bf9a`
(产物 fills in during the run) and `4a32d9b0` (the run's files reach an open
document, a subagent's answer is read whole).

The one place the two meet is 专家: #565 moved the add form into a modal owned
by the settings surface, so the composer's 新建… arrived through a
`SettingsIntent` that opened it. That form is now removed along with the button
that asked for it, and the intent goes with it.

## Uploaded files belong to the question that carried them

The composer accepted a drop, the file landed in the workspace, and the
transcript then showed a question with no sign of what was sent with it. The
user turn now carries its attachments as cards under the text: one card, two
cards side by side, and past that a count for the rest. Each card names the
file, its kind and its size, and is a link to the same file in the panel, so
"where did it go" is answered at the point the question is asked.

The count and the layout come from the transcript's own message, not from the
live upload state, so a reopened session draws the same cards as the one that
was just written. `src/views/uploads.ts` holds that reading; `UploadCards.tsx`
draws it.

## One stream per run, without the turn headings

The assistant's card had a `第 N 轮` heading per turn, so a run that used three
turns read as three sections rather than as one piece of work. The headings are
gone: the response, the next thought and the next tool call follow each other
in the order they happened. The turn number still exists on the wire and is
still what a replay is keyed by — it is simply not a line the reader follows.

A run that was stopped now ends with one divider saying 已停止 rather than a
cancellation notice per turn, and the runtime's own cancellation reasons are
recognised as that divider instead of being printed as an error.

## A tool block opens in the panel

The card's input and result were folds nested inside a fold, one click each to
read the output the card had already been opened for. They are now open code
tiles. Pressing a tile shows the same block at full width in the right panel —
the same mode the subagent line already used, so one panel still shows exactly
one record, and the second press on the same tile closes it.

This required the panel to learn a second non-tab mode. `ToolDetail` is the
panel's content there; `WorkspacePanel` takes `tool` beside `subagent` and the
two are mutually exclusive.

## 专家 is a catalog, not a label

The composer's 专家 row was a fixed 无/name label. It is now the session's bound
expert with a flyout that lists every expert, what each one does, and a search
that matches names — a description is deliberately not searched, so typing a
word that describes half the catalog does not return half the catalog. Choosing
one writes it to the session through `selectSpecialist`; 无 unbinds.

## A subagent's record says how it ran

The panel's subagent view opened straight into the brief. It now starts with a
status strip — status, turns, tokens — and a failure's reason sits under that
strip rather than after the timeline, where the reader had to scroll past the
child's whole execution to find out why it stopped.

## A subagent's 输出 is its closing message

The panel labelled the child's last assistant step as its output, and a reply
is not always one step: the runtime ends a step every time it records an event
in the middle of a message, so one answer can arrive as two adjacent assistant
steps that read as one sentence. The panel then cut the answer in half — its
opening stayed in the timeline while its tail was shown as the result. The
answer is now the trailing run of assistant steps joined, which is exactly how
the server's own `subagentFinalText` joins it before validating the child's
result, and every step of that run leaves the timeline so nothing is printed
twice.

A child that is still running has no 输出 section at all; what it has said so
far is progress, and it stays in the timeline where it was said.

## The API key field keeps the form's face

The shared rule for a secret input dressed it in the code face, and only the
first-run wizard overrode that. In 添加模型 — the same form, in the settings
shell — the key's placeholder was therefore a monospaced line between two
proportional ones, reading as a different kind of control from 基础URL and
模型名称 directly above and below it. The rule no longer sets a face at all,
and the wizard's now-redundant override is gone.

## 设置 › 技能 says what a skill is

Four things a skill's card got wrong, all of them visible at once on a skill
created from the form:

- **It was created off.** `all` — the default — already means every installed
  skill, so a package made under it is on and no write is needed; a project
  that carries an explicit list gains the new id, which is the same write a
  toggle makes. The two cases are told apart by `skillSelectionMode`, because
  writing the list under `all` would pin the project to `selected` and freeze
  the catalog behind it.
- **The version read `vrevision:1`** — the server's own `revision:1` label for
  a package that declared no version, printed after the `v` the card adds. An
  undeclared version now reads `第 N 版` and a declared one `v1.2.0`; the source
  reads 内置 / 自建 rather than the wire's `built-in` / `managed`.
- **The file count read `0 个文件`** for a package that is SKILL.md and nothing
  else: `resourceSummary.files` counts the files *beside* SKILL.md. The card
  counts SKILL.md too, which is a file the package always has.
- **The expanded half repeated the description** printed above the divider. It
  now reads the skill itself (`GET /api/skills/:id`) and shows the body of
  SKILL.md under 指令 — what the model is told, which is the one thing the row
  above cannot say.

## The panel's mode belongs to an open panel

The panel has three modes: the tab pair (产物 / 工作区), a subagent's record,
and a tool block. Only the first is the panel itself; the other two are records
opened *from* the transcript. Closing the panel left the record selected, so
reopening it — from the card or from the toolbar's toggle — showed that record
again, and a second press on the same card closed it instead of opening it.
`collapsePanel` now clears the mode with the panel: the reader closed the
panel, not the record, and asking for the panel back asks for its groups.

The group is part of that state too. The toolbar's toggle reopened on whichever
of 产物 / 工作区 had been showing, so a reader who had been browsing the file
tree got the tree back from a button labelled 工作区面板. The group now resets
with the panel: a fresh open lands on 产物, which is what a run produces, and
only an explicit click on 工作区 — or an upload, which is asking where the file
went — moves it.

The artifact list now names the Session above its rows even when it is the only
one. The heading used to appear only from the second Session on, so the list
changed shape as a Project grew, and the sample's single Session showed a bare
list of files under the panel's 所有产物 title. An artifact belongs to the
Session that made it; the heading says so from the first row.

## 产物 fills in while the run is still writing

The panel read its artifact list and workspace tree at four moments — opening a
Session, after an upload, and when a run settled — and never while a run was
writing. The service publishes `artifact.upserted` and `workspace.changed` as
the artifacts and files appear, and the run reducer lists both as deliberately
undrawn, so a reply that published three artifacts showed all three only after
it ended. On a long run that is the whole time the reader is waiting.

Both frames now ask `refreshPanel` for a read. The read is throttled by
`app/panel-refresh.ts`, a leading-and-trailing throttle rather than a debounce:
the first frame of a quiet run reads at once, so an artifact appears mid-reply,
and further frames inside 1.2 s collapse into one read when the window closes,
so a tool call that writes file after file costs one request per window rather
than one per file, and a burst that never pauses is still followed. A pending
read is dropped when the Session is left, so it cannot fire for the Session the
reader moved to.

Nothing in the transcript changes. The list is re-read rather than folded in
from the frame, because it spans Sessions and every version and a read is what
keeps it agreeing with the catalog; the frame only says that the moment has
changed.

The same read keeps the workspace half live, and two details were needed to
make that true in practice. The artifact list and the tree are now read
independently: `Promise.all` meant a failed artifact listing held the tree on
the files it had before the run. And the tree is only the index — a document
already open in the panel kept the text it was opened with, so a report the run
rewrites in place sat behind its own updated row. The refresh compares the new
listing with the one the panel showed, by size and modification time
(`app/file-changes.ts`), and reads back the documents whose files moved.

## A Project name is its own

Two Projects could be created with one name, and the sidebar then held two rows
the reader could not tell apart; the name is the only handle a Project has.
`createProject` and a rename refuse a name another Project already answers to —
`409`, compared case- and whitespace-insensitively, inside the settings queue,
so two creates racing on one name cannot both pass. The sidebar refuses it
first, under the field: `src/app/project-name.ts` holds the rule and
`PromptDialog` gained the `validate` hook that prints the refusal in place
(`role="alert"`) rather than closing the dialog and explaining it in a toast.

Two callers relied on the old freedom and now name or reuse distinctly: the
launcher reuses the Project it created for its own commands, and the research
journey gives each protocol its own Project.

## A new Project starts with every skill on

`withDefaultProjectSkillSettings` wrote `skillSelectionMode: "selected"` with no
ids, which is a Project with no skills at all. It writes `all` now, explicitly,
so the Project carries the choice it was made with and a later change under
全局 › 技能 does not silently move it; a skill installed afterwards joins it
without any write.

## A first install opens on a real Session

A new data directory opened on an empty sidebar, so the desktop's first run
showed nothing of what a Session is. `services/api/src/sample-session` seeds
one: 脓毒症亚型聚类分析, an end-to-end sepsis endotyping analysis, in a Project
of its own. It is named after the question it answered — the recording's own
"Session 10-26 01:40" says only when it was made.

The 产物 tab reads the catalog, and an artifact is a catalog record whose bytes
live in the content store, so a payload of workspace files alone leaves that
tab empty. The sample now publishes what the run published: four versions over
three artifacts — the audit report, the answer and the trace, which was
rewritten and kept both ways — written through the same `createArtifactVersion`
call the run used, with each blob in the content store first. The version
picker and the artifact reader therefore work on the sample exactly as they do
on a Session the user ran. The 2.3 MB input table stays out: it is an upload
rather than an output, it is not in the payload's workspace, and a row that
cannot open is worse than no row.

The payload is the Session as the desktop wrote it to disk — messages, runs,
run streams and the workspace the analysis left behind — gzipped and
base64-encoded inside the API build, because a deployed service carries only
`dist`. The seeder inflates it and fills in the ids and data directory the
files were written with. Installed packages, bytecode caches and the 2.3 MB
input table are excluded; the two figures travel as base64 because they are not
text; absolute paths, Session and Project ids, and the account and host names a
directory listing had printed are replaced.

Seeding runs once, before run recovery, and only when the install has no
conversation of its own; a marker stops a deleted sample from returning. A
failure is logged and swallowed — a convenience that cannot be written is not a
reason for the service not to start. A config built by hand leaves the flag
unset and stays empty; `loadServerConfig` turns it on, and
`SCIENCE_AGENT_SAMPLE_SESSION=0` turns it off.

## The first run walks three steps

The wizard opened on the provider form alone, on the reasoning that the shell
had already chosen the data directory and started the service. That holds for
where the data goes, but not for what the user is shown: a launch with no model
landed on a page asking for an API key without having said where the work will
be stored or whether the runtime is ready — the two questions the shell's own
wizard answers before it hands over.

The wizard is now three steps in the shell's order. The workspace step records
the directory rather than moving it: no route reports or changes the live data
directory, so the field says where the data goes, offers the shell's native
picker and its writability / free-space check when the preload bridge is
present, and states in the note under the field that editing it does not
relocate what is already there. Both exits — 下一步 and 跳过并使用默认位置 —
write the note to `localStorage` and open the environment step; skipping clears
it, which is how "use the default" was expressed before.

The environment step is the shell's 启动与自检 page kept as a step. It asks the
preload bridge for the live backend status instead of starting anything, then
runs the same self-check (local API, execution engine, optional default model)
with the same pending → ✓ / – states and the same three-minute budget, and the
same 重新检查 once that budget is spent. In a plain browser there is no bridge,
so it probes `/api/health` and `/api/settings` and shows the execution engine as
"not checked" rather than failed; `HealthReport.runner` now carries the
`execution.ready` capability that decision reads.

The provider step is unchanged apart from 返回上一步, which `ModelForm` gains as
a `trailingAction` so it sits in the action row after 测试并继续 rather than on a
line of its own under the form.

## `/` opens the skill palette

The composer's draft is the only state. A draft that is one `/` command — a
leading slash, then characters with no space among them — shows the palette,
and the space after a pick is what closes it; `/` on a later line of a longer
message therefore does not open it, and no extra flag has to be kept in step.
Arrow keys move, Tab or Enter picks, Escape dismisses, and a pick writes
`/skill-id ` with the caret at the end, ready for the request after it. The
service already expands a known id into its full prompt and passes the rest
through.

Each row is drawn with the skill's own mark — its initial, on the same tile
设置 › 技能 gives every card — rather than the slash that opened the palette.
Both lists read `skillMark`, so the same catalog looks the same in either, and
two skills no longer share one glyph.

## Two 新增 entry points are gone

设置 › MCP 服务器 and 设置 › 专家 each opened a blank form from a button in the
page header, and the composer's 专家 flyout carried a 新建… to the same form.
Both lists are catalogues of what is installed; a blank form in the header was
a way to something the user could not complete there. The buttons, the `adding`
flags they set, the `SettingsIntent` that carried the composer's request and
新建… itself are removed. Editing a row is untouched.

The line under 设置 › MCP 服务器 still described custom servers as addable at
any time, which the removal made false. That sentence is gone in both
languages; the rest of what the line explained — built-in servers ship enabled,
their tools come from the server catalog, the switch controls the server rather
than a session's choice of sources — is unchanged.

## 技能, MCP 服务器 and 专家 each flip a whole list

A user who wanted none of a list had to press every switch. The three panes
share `BulkToggles` and each page decides what "all" means for its own rows.
The pair is drawn as one segmented control rather than two blue text links: it
is one choice about the whole list, and a joined border, a hover surface, a
focus ring and a disabled state say so before either label is read. On
技能 it is one call — every installed id, or the empty list, which flips the
mode to `selected`, because under `all` the Project carries no list to edit. On
专家 it is the built-ins, since a written expert is always on. On MCP 服务器 it
is each custom server's own `enabled` flag plus one global write for the
built-in sources, sequential because some servers reconnect on the way in.

## Validation

Repository layers, run on `4a32d9b0`:

- `pnpm ci:ut` — 5038 planned, 5038 executed, 5036 passed, 2 failed, 0 skipped.
  Neither failure is this change's: the trajectory test fails identically on a
  detached worktree of unmodified `main` (`1778aafa`), and the sandbox test
  stops inside `bwrap` before it reaches product code. An earlier run of the
  same tree, before this branch was rebased onto `main`, reported four: the same
  two, plus `run-cancel`'s usage case and `server.test`'s queued-runs case,
  which passed when run on their own and in this run — they fail only while the
  machine is loaded, and nothing here touches `services/`.
  - `services/runner/src/sandbox-network.test.ts` — *a real sandbox reaches
    allowed domains through the gateway and nothing else* — `bwrap: Unknown
    option --disable-userns`: this host's bubblewrap predates the flag the
    sandbox is launched with.
  - `services/api/src/agent-run/jiuwenswarm-agent.test.ts` — *the run's
    trajectory is recorded from the model calls JiuwenSwarm makes…* — expects
    `context.captured`, `model.completed`, `state.committed` for the title call
    and receives only `model.completed`.
- `pnpm ci:st` — 24 planned, 24 executed, 22 passed, 2 failed, 0 skipped. Both
  failures are environmental — they need a download this host cannot complete —
  and neither loads anything this change touches.
  - `check:swarm-sdk-contract` — JiuwenSwarm cannot be installed here
    (`uv sync --python 3.12` cannot reach the index).
  - `test/api/evolve-distribution.test.ts` — needs a pinned
    `python-build-standalone` tarball, whose body does not transfer; the child
    stalls until its 300 s timeout.
- `pnpm ci:e2e` — see *E2E user journeys* below.

Desktop application:

- `npm run typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) — clean; `pnpm build` — clean.
- `npm test` — 468 tests, 468 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. Includes the new
  name rule, the palette's filter, mark and draft, the removed entry points, the
  bulk toggle's pages, the panel's default group and its per-Session headings,
  the sample Session's seeding, its artifacts and its one-shot marker, each of
  the wizard's three steps rendered on its own, the panel refresh's throttle
  (first read immediate, burst coalesced, pending read dropped on leave)
  together with which stream events request it, the file fingerprints that
  decide what an open document is read from, and the subagent panel's 输出 —
  absent while the child runs, joined when the runtime split one reply across
  steps.

## E2E user journeys

PASS for the browser journeys driven against the built app (`vite preview` on
`28d3e71f`), its own API build and a data directory seeded by this branch, so
the sessions below are real runs with real tool calls. The checks below were
re-run against this head (28 browser assertions — 16 across the panel, the
palette, the settings panes and the sample, 10 on a first launch with no model,
2 on the MCP page's help line), and all passed:

| Scenario | Expected | Actual |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Open a session with a long run and expand its fold | One chronological stream of thinking and tool lines, no per-turn heading | PASS — thinking and `已调用` lines in order, no `第 N 轮` |
| Expand a tool card | Input and output drawn as labeled tiles, not nested folds | PASS — `输入` / `输出` tiles with values |
| Press a result tile | The panel opens on that block as `工具调用 <name>` | PASS — panel head `工具调用 read_skill`, body `is-tool` |
| Press a subagent card, close the panel, press the same card | The child's record opens again | PASS — 4 subagent lines; the record reopens |
| Close the panel, press the toolbar's panel toggle | 产物 / 工作区, not the record that was up | PASS — `.panel-group-tabs` present |
| Type `/` in the composer | The skill palette lists skills and a pick writes the command | PASS — 8 options; Enter wrote `/assessment-screening ` |
| Open 添加模型 | The API key's placeholder is drawn in the form's face, like its neighbours | PASS — all three fields Inter 13px, placeholder `rgb(140, 140, 140)` |
| Create a skill in 设置 › 技能 | The card arrives on, with a readable version and file count | PASS — `verify-default-on 已启用`, `自建 · 第 1 版 · 1 个文件` |
| Open that card | The expanded half shows SKILL.md's body, not the description again | PASS — `指令`, then the text the form was given |
| Open 设置 › MCP 服务器 / 专家 / 技能 | No 新增 entry; both bulk buttons present | PASS — all three panes; 一键关闭 then 一键启用 on 专家 writes and reads back |
| 新建项目 with an existing name | Refused under the field and nothing created | PASS — `已存在同名项目「示例项目」，请换一个名称` |
| Start the API on an empty data directory | One Project 示例项目 holding 脓毒症亚型聚类分析, its runs, its workspace and its artifacts | PASS — 2 runs, `analysis_summary.md`, 211 workspace files, `GET /artifact-outputs` returns 4 rows; a second start does not repeat the seed |
| Open the sample's 产物 tab | Three artifacts listed under the Session, each opening on its text | PASS — `audit_report.md`, `trace.md`, `answer.txt`; `trace.md` opens on v2 (34,927 bytes) with the version picker |
| Close the panel from 工作区, press the toolbar's toggle | 产物, headed by the Session's name | PASS — `.panel-group-tab.is-active` is 产物; heading `脓毒症亚型聚类分析 当前会话` over 3 rows |
| Type `/` in the composer | Each row carries the skill's initial, as 设置 › 技能 draws it | PASS — palette marks `A,A,C,C,C,C,E,E` equal the settings cards' |
| Look at 一键启用 / 一键关闭 in 设置 › 技能 | One segmented control, not two loose links | PASS — 80×30 joined pair, hover and disabled states, focus ring |
| Launch against a data directory with no model | The wizard opens on the workspace, then the environment check, then the provider — each step ahead of the one it needs | PASS — `data-step` walks `workspace` → `boot` → `model`; the note says the field records rather than moves |
| Type a directory, press 下一步, then come back and press 跳过，用默认值 | The path is recorded and returns to the field; skipping clears it | PASS — `localStorage` `sciencediscovery-desktop:data-dir` = `/tmp/wizard-demo`, then `""` |
| Wait on the environment step with a live service | Local API and the execution engine pass, the optional model is “not checked”, then 环境已就绪 and 下一步：配置模型 | PASS — three rows (`is-ok`, `is-ok`, plain), the engine read from `runner.execution.ready` |
| Press 返回上一步 on the provider step | It sits after 测试并继续 in the action row and returns to the check step | PASS — `["测试并继续","返回上一步"]`, back on `data-step="boot"` |
| Open 设置 › MCP 服务器 | The line under the heading describes only what the page still does, and offers no way to add a server | PASS — “内置服务器随产品提供、默认开启…” with no sentence about custom servers, and no 新增 button |

The panel's live refresh — and the open document it now reads again — is the
one change on this head without a browser journey: driving it needs a run that
publishes an artifact or rewrites a file mid-stream, which needs a live model,
and the isolated E2E stack that would supply one does not start on this host
(below). It is covered by unit tests instead — the throttle (five cases:
immediate first read, coalesced burst, one read per window while writing
continues, trailing read after the window, dropped pending read), the set of
events that request it, and the fingerprint comparison that decides which
documents are read back (a rewritten file by size or by time, an untouched one
by neither, a first listing as everything new, a removed file as nothing) —
and by the desktop typecheck and build.

The subagent panel's 输出 is rendered statically in the same suite, because
the case that was wrong needs a child whose reply the runtime split across two
steps; the sample Session's children finished in one step each, so the browser
shows nothing unusual there. A running child has no 输出 section, a completed
one shows the joined closing message, and prose the child wrote before it
reached a tool stays in the timeline.

The desktop suite's own browser subset (`pnpm ci:e2e`): BLOCKED — 119 planned,
0 executed, 0 passed. All three groups (mocked-standard, mocked-research,
mocked-literature) stop before Playwright starts: each runs the isolated stack,
which builds its `paper` scientific environment with `uv sync`, and that stalls
on the same download every time (`Downloading pillow (6.6MiB)` never finishes),
so the stack's health probe gives up. No journey is reported as passing here
that did not run.

## Release

Release category: `release:feature` (the GitHub label is pending a maintainer —
this account can open the pull request but cannot apply labels upstream)

User impact: 产物 and the workspace tree fill in while a reply is still being
written, instead of all at once when it ends, and a file the run rewrites
reaches the document already open in the panel; a subagent's 输出 is its whole
closing message rather than the last fragment of it; the first run walks three
steps — where the workspace lives, a check of the local API and the execution
engine, then the provider — and the
workspace field says plainly that it records a location rather than moving
existing data; a first install then opens on a real Session — 脓毒症亚型聚类分析 —
with its transcript, tool blocks, workspace and its three artifacts; the
panel's toolbar toggle always opens 产物, with the artifacts grouped under the
Session that made them; a duplicate Project name is refused where it is typed;
a new Project has every skill on; 技能, MCP 服务器 and 专家 can be switched
wholesale, above a list drawn as one segmented control; `/` in the composer
lists skills under the mark 设置 gives them; and 新增MCP服务器 / 新增专家 are
gone.

Compatibility and migration: one behaviour change — a Project name is now
unique, so an API client that creates two Projects with the same name gets a
`409`. No storage or configuration migration; existing data directories are
left alone, and the sample Session is only written into an install that has no
conversation of its own. `SCIENCE_AGENT_SAMPLE_SESSION=0` opts out.

pr:585.body:
> Rebased onto `main` after #584 merged (`0bb6d493`), which carries every desktop UI change this work was measured against. Only the last commit belongs to this PR: `apps/desktop/tests/**`, `apps/desktop/e2e/**` and `apps/desktop/e2e-real/**`.

## What this adds

`apps/desktop` had a handful of static tests and no browser entry of its own, so most of what a reader can do in the app was unproven. This branch adds three layers over the same surface. The layers answer different questions and are counted separately: a mocked case is never evidence for a real one.

`apps/desktop/tests/TEST-PLAN.md` records every scenario the app exposes, its priority, which layer proves it, and its CI tier — plus the defects found while writing the cases (listed at the end).

## L2 — static and unit cases (11 files, 93 new cases)

Collected by the shared tagged catalog (`apps/desktop/tests/**/*.test.*` in `test/support/tagged/profiles.mjs`), tagged `category:ut`, so they run in the existing UT slice on a non-draft PR. With the files that were already there, the catalog collects 561 desktop cases in total.

| File | Cases | What it proves |
|---|---|---|
| `tests/api-sessions.test.ts` | 14 | Project/Session reads, status filter, detail, create, update, runs, subagents, cancel (named run and current), workspace files and artifact versions, the `confirmationId` a delete must carry, the Runner allowlist including `local`, the inbox lookup |
| `tests/api-settings.test.ts` | 14 | Every 设置 write path: language, timeouts, sandbox, specialists, MCP servers (test/stop/start), skills, and the payload each one sends |
| `tests/api-models.test.ts` | 7 | Provider and model writes, the default profile, model deletion, and a failed probe that is saved but never becomes the default |
| `tests/api-remote.test.ts` | 7 | Remote hosts: registration, ssh_config parsing, key state, trusting a host key, removal |
| `tests/api-permissions.test.ts` | 3 | The approval a run's tool call asks for, and the decision sent back |
| `tests/boot-screens.test.tsx` | 7 | 启动中 / 服务未就绪 / 需要登录 / 首次运行, and the screen each state renders; the wizard's workspace step, its model step (`initialStep`) and the custom-protocol branch |
| `tests/dialogs.test.tsx` | 6 | `ConfirmDialog`, `PromptDialog`, Escape handling, focus and the empty-name refusal |
| `tests/settings-screens.test.tsx` | 11 | First paint of each 设置 pane: categories, no footer, the language picker showing the language in force, the live delete control, the specialist and MCP cards |
| `tests/sidebar-extra.test.tsx` | 8 | Relative dates (minutes, days, weeks), the six-row fold with 显示更多, the running spinner on its own row, empty-project and empty-recent copy |
| `tests/session-bar.test.tsx` | 6 | Title, project, timestamp, the 未命名会话 name for a draft, the panel control's visibility, a collapsed sidebar's expand control |
| `tests/runner-resources.test.tsx` | 10 | Runner catalog and resource bars: NPU rows, device selection, an empty catalog, an unreachable Runner |
| `tests/api-stub.ts` | — | Shared fetch stub for the API cases (no cases of its own) |

## L2 — mocked browser cases (11 specs, 69 cases)

A desktop-only Playwright entry: it serves the Vite app on port 4175 and answers `/api/**` from memory, so a journey can start with no token, no project and no model — the states the repository-wide `.e2e` suite cannot provide. An endpoint the mock does not know answers `404 not mocked` rather than an empty success.

| Spec | Cases | What it proves |
|---|---|---|
| `e2e/boot.spec.ts` | 6 | Every boot state through to a usable workspace, including an empty one where the inbox is the only Project |
| `e2e/setup.spec.ts` | 1 | The three-step first run — workspace directory, environment self-check, provider — and 开始使用 stays hidden until 测试并继续 passes |
| `e2e/conversation.spec.ts` | 2 | Send → stream → persist; Stop ends the run |
| `e2e/sessions.spec.ts` | 2 | Rename and delete survive a reload; deleting the open Session leaves a draft |
| `e2e/settings.spec.ts` | 2 | A chosen default model and the interface language survive a reload |
| `e2e/workspace.spec.ts` | 4 | Upload through the picker, the window-wide drag overlay, the health-reported size ceiling, and an archived session refusing the drop |
| `e2e/settings-interactions.spec.ts` | 20 | The write-on-press behaviour of every 设置 pane: specialists, MCP servers, timeouts, skills and models, including a refused write and a delete confirmation. The MCP and specialist pages offer only edit and delete on this baseline, so their forms are driven from an existing card |
| `e2e/remote-hosts.spec.ts` | 13 | Remote machine cards: add from ssh_config, key states, trust, connect, delete, the allowlist, NPU pinning |
| `e2e/shell-interactions.spec.ts` | 9 | The panel toggle hands over to its own collapse, rename refuses an empty name, the welcome page's category → topic → composer chain, toast lifetimes, GitHub star cache and its offline state, and a confirmation's Escape closing only one layer |
| `e2e/panel-interactions.spec.ts` | 7 | Artifact groups across Sessions, the two searches, the version picker replacing a document in the same tab, a failed read retried by the row, and the list divider's keys |
| `e2e/structure-viewer.spec.ts` | 2 | A structure file opens Mol* with its badge and full screen; a text file does not |

Run it with:

```bash
PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH="$PWD/.e2e/browsers" \
  apps/desktop/e2e/node_modules/.bin/playwright test \
  --config apps/desktop/e2e/playwright.config.ts
```

## L3 — real-backend variants (6 files, 8 cases)

The same journeys against a real API, a real Runner and a real model, tagged `@real @model:real @tier:l3`, for the merge gate. Each skips by name — never silently — when the stack, the token or the model is missing.

| File | Cases | Journey |
|---|---|---|
| `e2e-real/setup.real.spec.ts` | 1 | First-run wizard against a real endpoint (needs an empty model catalog) |
| `e2e-real/models.real.spec.ts` | 1 | 设置 › 模型 › 测试连接 against the real endpoint |
| `e2e-real/conversation.real.spec.ts` | 2 | Real stream and persistence; Stop cancels the live Run |
| `e2e-real/permission.real.spec.ts` | 1 | Approving a real `run_shell` lets the same Run finish |
| `e2e-real/workspace.real.spec.ts` | 1 | Real upload, file list and preview |
| `e2e-real/runner.real.spec.ts` | 2 | The real Runner catalog: local allowlist, and a connected remote Runner's resources |

pr:594.body:
## Related issue

Fixes the behaviour reported in #435: Automatic review accepted a reproduction report whose required output (`output/{instance}/predictions.npy`) was absent, presented a citation-only pass as an overall pass, and kept showing that ACCEPT after the report had been rewritten.

## Root cause

The Quick checkpoint returned `PASSED` / `ACCEPT_AND_PROCEDE` whenever the citation checks produced no findings. It never asked whether the task's own deliverables existed, and nothing in the review record said which part of the task a verdict covered. Separately, `GET /api/sessions/:id/artifact-reviews` returned a review as if it were the current verdict even after its Artifact had a newer version.

## What changed

### `packages/schema`
- `ArtifactReviewRun.completeness: ArtifactReviewCompleteness` — per declared path `present | missing | empty`, plus `status: complete | incomplete | unconfirmed`, `source: brief | session-fallback | none` (only `brief` is authoritative enough to re-derive a reused verdict) and `scope: run | session`.
- `ArtifactReviewRun.checks` gains `"completeness"`.
- `stale` / `staleSinceVersionId`: computed on read, never persisted, so the recorded decision is not rewritten.

### `packages/provenance`
- `RunReviewerCheckpointOptions.requiredDeliverables` and `evaluateDeliverableCompleteness()` — deterministic, no model call: every declared path is `present`, `empty` or `missing`.
- A missing or empty requirement adds a critical `DELIVERABLE_MISSING` / `DELIVERABLE_EMPTY` finding and forces `REVISE_AND_RETRY`; no ACCEPT is possible while a required file is absent or empty.
- No structured declaration → `completeness: { status: "unconfirmed", source: "none" }`, no `completeness` check is claimed, and the internal feedback line reads `SCOPE_LIMITED` instead of `PASSED`.
- Matching uses the recorded `sourcePath` only (a model-chosen Artifact label cannot stand in for the file), strips exactly one leading `subagents/<id>/` segment, then requires equality: a leftover `archive/2026-10-01/output/cl3/predictions.npy` cannot stand in for this run's deliverable, a bare `predictions.npy` cannot be satisfied by `output/cl5/predictions.npy`, and a root-level deliverable (`REPRODUCTION_REPORT.md`) still matches its own bare declaration.
- `QUICK_REVIEWER_VERSION` / `SEMANTIC_REVIEWER_VERSION` → `2.5.0-deliverable-completeness`, so a review recorded before the completeness field existed is never reused as a verdict.

### `services/api`
- `reviewer-specialist/required-deliverables.ts` takes only explicit relative file paths from a Brief's `outputRequirements`; absolute paths, URLs, globs, free text and extension-less names are rejected, so the review says "unconfirmed" instead of guessing.
- Both checkpoint call sites pass them (`runs/index.ts` agent tool, `http/index.ts` automatic/manual audit), so the Automatic review path from #435 is covered.
- `auditReviewContext()` is the single entry both audit paths use: the task's synthetic `automatic-review:<taskId>` / `manual-review:<messageId>` id is never treated as a run id. `reviewedRunIds()` reads the runs from the reviewed Artifact versions and maps a subagent's own product (`turnId == subagent.id`) back to the run that started it; every distinct run in one merged checkpoint is kept, so a run-A report is never judged with only run-B's Brief.
- A Session-wide fallback carries `source: "session-fallback"` and `scope: "session"`, is spelled out in the main-Agent feedback, and is never used to re-derive a reused verdict; it only applies when the reviewed run ran no subagent at all. A run whose subagents were `cancelled` / `timed_out` stays unconfirmed instead of borrowing another run's list.
- `reviewer-specialist/review-staleness.ts` plus the `artifact-reviews` endpoint mark a review whose Artifact has a newer version. Re-review of the new version keeps using the existing `ReviewerAuditCoordinator` batch (no new queue, no new switch).

### `apps/web`
- An ACCEPT whose task declared no structured deliverable is labelled **"Checks passed; delivery not verified"** (zh: 检查通过；交付未验证), with warning tone.
- The same card — no stacked extra card — gains one delivery-completeness line naming the exact missing/empty paths, and **Outdated / 已过期** for a review that answers an older Artifact version.
- `DELIVERABLE_MISSING` / `DELIVERABLE_EMPTY` findings are localized (en, zh).

### `docs`
- en/zh ScienceMemory & Reviewer page: what the deliverable check does, that presence is not correctness, and what a stale review means.

## Behaviour evidence (actual output, this branch)

```
1) missing deliverable -> decision=REVISE_AND_RETRY findings=DELIVERABLE_MISSING/critical promptHas(revision:true, passed:false)
   Status: REVISION_REQUIRED | Delivery completeness: INCOMPLETE. Missing or empty required files: output/cl3/predictions.npy (missing).
2) present deliverable -> completeness=complete decision=ACCEPT_AND_PROCEDE checks=citation,completeness
   Delivery completeness: COMPLETE. ... Presence only; content and scientific correctness were not verified.
3) no declaration -> completeness=unconfirmed source=none checks=citation promptStatus=Status: SCOPE_LIMITED
   UI label: "Checks passed; delivery not verified"
4a) single version -> HTTP 200 stale=undefined
4b) newer version    -> HTTP 200 stale=true staleSinceVersionId=<new version id> reviewedVersion=<old version id>
5) automatic audit of a report whose run declared output/cl3/predictions.npy (absent)
   -> completeness.source=brief scope=run status=incomplete decision=REVISE_AND_RETRY finding=DELIVERABLE_MISSING
6) same Session, manual re-review of the same report -> identical verdict (synthetic manual-review:<id> is not a run)
7) subagent-written report (version turnId == subagent id) -> run mapped back to its parentRunId, Brief found, REVISE (not "unconfirmed")
8) reused review + a Session fallback that would pass -> stays REVISE_AND_RETRY / incomplete / DELIVERABLE_MISSING (a fallback never re-derives)
9) one checkpoint merging a run-A and a run-B version -> both runs' declared paths are enforced (run-B present, run-A missing -> REVISE)
```

The four behaviours were produced with the production `runReviewerCheckpoint`, `reviewerCheckpointPromptContent`, a real `SessionStore` and a real `createApiServer` (`GET /api/sessions/:id/artifact-reviews`), not with mocks of the changed functions.

## UI evidence

![Reviewer card states: plain pass before, then scope limited, missing deliverable, and satisfied deliverable](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/fix/issue-435-deliverable-completeness/docs/images/reviewer-delivery-completeness.png)

Rendered from the real `ReviewerPanel` component with the application stylesheet (four states, top to bottom):

1. before this change — a citation-only pass was shown as a plain pass;
2. no structured deliverable declared — the card is labelled "Checks passed; delivery not verified", says the completeness was not verified, is marked "Outdated" for an older version, and the panel summary reads "1 delivery not verified" instead of "1 passed";
3. declared deliverable missing — "Revision required", the finding names `output/cl3/predictions.npy`, and the delivery line repeats the path;
4. declared deliverable present — the card says the required file exists and is non-empty, and states that content and scientific correctness were not verified.


## Local verification (commands and real numbers)

```
pnpm build                                       -> all workspace packages built
pnpm typecheck                                   -> recursive typecheck + tsconfig.tests.json OK
pnpm architecture:check                          -> 69 pass / 0 fail; "Architecture boundaries OK (293 package source files checked)"
pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/web test         -> 1058 pass / 0 fail (65s)
cd services/api && node --import tsx --test "src/reviewer-specialist/*.test.ts"
                                                 -> 146 pass / 0 fail
npx tsx --test tests/ReviewerPanel.test.tsx (apps/web) -> 22 pass / 0 fail
node --import tsx --test src/store.test.ts \
  src/http/{bootstrap-tokens,error-classification,execution-readiness,static}.test.ts
                                                 -> 130 pass / 0 fail
pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/api test (whole suite) -> 1398 tests, 1387 pass, 11 fail
markdownlint-cli2                                -> 0 issues (144 files)
```

The 11 failures of the whole API suite are environment gaps on this machine, not assertions in the changed code: `services/paper/.venv` and `services/evolve/.venv` are not installed (`spawn ... ENOENT`), `bwrap` is not installed, and the Codex/Claude/ACP specialist transports are unavailable. Nothing in them touches the Reviewer, provenance or Artifact code.

## How to test

```
pnpm build    # tests import the built @sciencediscovery/provenance
cd services/api && node --import tsx --test src/reviewer-specialist/review-checkpoint.test.ts \
                                            src/reviewer-specialist/required-deliverables.test.ts \
                                            src/reviewer-specialist/review-staleness.test.ts
cd apps/web && npx tsx --test tests/ReviewerPanel.test.tsx
```

Browser walkthrough (the one in the issue decision): open a session whose Brief declares `output/cl3/predictions.npy`, run a reproduction that does not produce it → the Reviewer card shows "Revision required" plus the missing path and must not show a pass; write the file and register a new report version → the old review shows "Outdated" and the new version queues for review in the same place.

## Known limitations

1. The only authoritative deliverable source is a Brief's `outputRequirements` entries that are explicit relative file paths. Free-text requirements, absolute paths, URLs and globs are ignored on purpose, so such tasks report "delivery not verified" (unconfirmed) instead of a pass. *
1a. Declarations of subagents in the *same* run are treated as one delivery list: if worker A's report is reviewed, a file only worker B was asked for is still demanded. The Artifact record does not say which report belongs to which worker's handoff, so splitting it would mean guessing. Cross-run declarations are now kept apart (one review covers every run whose version it reviews). *
1b. A later run that only rewrites the report has no Brief of its own; it falls back to the Session's live declarations, marked `source: "session-fallback"` / `scope: "session"` in the record and in the main-Agent feedback.*This means a Quick review of a task with no structured declaration no longer shows `PASSED` — that is the #435 decision (交付完整性未确认时不得宣称整体交付通过).**
2. The completeness check verifies existence and non-emptiness only. It never claims content, computation or scientific correctness; the UI text says so explicitly.
3. Staleness is computed on read in the `artifact-reviews` endpoint (the path the web UI uses). Other consumers of `listArtifactReviews` still receive the stored record without the marker.
4. If a session has no narrative report among the reviewed versions, the delivery verdict is attached to the first reviewed version instead of a report.
5. Existing stored reviews are not backfilled: a review recorded before this change has no `completeness` field and keeps its old label.
6. No new user-facing switch was added, as required; Automatic review on/off behaviour is unchanged.
7. Squashing the branch to three commits was not done: one commit (`73a29b9d`, the screenshot) was pushed by a concurrent run in the same working copy while this branch was already pushed. Rewriting that history would need a force-push, which this workflow forbids.

- A merged audit batch evaluates every report against the run that produced it. When a version carries no run (or its run delegated nothing) the check falls back to the Session's declarations and records `source: "session-fallback"`, which never re-derives a reused verdict. Subagents that belong to the same run still contribute one union, so a report from that run is judged against all of that run's declared files.
- Call-site coverage: the Reviewer audit runner (`http/index.ts`, automatic and manual) has **no unit test of its own** — `createApiServer` is module level. `auditReviewContext` / `reviewedRunId` / `requirementsForVersion` are exported and covered directly, and the call site is covered by manual HTTP verification; the real `declare_artifact → automatic audit` path needs CI L2 (this machine has no bwrap/runner).


- Matching is exact after removing one `subagents/<id>/` prefix. A declaration that omits a leading directory reads as `missing`: any looser rule is indistinguishable from an earlier attempt (`archive/2026-10-01/…`, `old/…`) standing in for this run's file.
- A per-version resolver answering `undefined` is final for that report: the batch-wide set never fills the gap, so a cancelled run's report is unconfirmed rather than certified with another run's file.
- A checkpoint that reviewed nothing reports `Status: NO_ARTIFACTS`; the manual path no longer reads as `PASSED`.


- **Exact matching cost.** A requirement matches exactly after removing one `subagents/<id>/` prefix. A Brief that omits a leading directory (`cl3/predictions.npy` for `output/cl3/predictions.npy`) reads as `missing`, and a historical Brief does not heal. The declaration format is instructed in this PR (`packages/workspace/src/workspace.ts`: "a bare relative path that includes its directory, for example `output/cl3/predictions.npy`"), so this is a non-conforming declaration rather than a legitimate one being misjudged.
- **No unit test executes the audit call site.** `reviewCheckpointInput` is covered by tests that fail when the per-report resolver is replaced by a batch-wide set; the line that calls it in `http/index.ts` is covered by manual HTTP verification, and the real `declare_artifact → automatic audit` path depends on CI L2.
- **Bounded matching was evaluated and rejected.** Tolerating `output/` or `outputs/` as a leading segment was implemented and tested locally (157 pass) but not adopted: it couples the tolerance to the workspace directory naming. Revisit only with a real sample of a conforming declaration being misjudged.


- **When changing Reviewer behaviour, three assertion families must be checked together.** ① `apps/web/tests/*` (component level, runnable locally via `npm test`); ② `services/api/src/**/*.test.ts` (server unit, runnable locally); ③ `test/journey-*.spec.ts` (Playwright E2E, run by CI's `L2 E2E (mocked, <shard>)` job, needs bwrap and cannot run on a developer machine). The two locally runnable suites are **not** the whole repository: `c5ec5b7f` turned `journey-reviewer-result-matrix` from green to red precisely because only the first two were run.


## Commits

| `081ee362` | fix(reviewer): refuse a delivery pass when required deliverables are missing or unknown |
| `e49b5acf` | feat(reviewer): read an outdated Artifact review as stale history |

## CLA

This PR was opened by `sciencediscovery-bot`, so `license/cla` will stay **pending**: an App installation token cannot sign the CLA. A human needs to either add the bot to the CLA allowlist or re-open the PR from a human account before it can merge.

## Problem

Issue #589 reports two opaque `run_python` failures before the model finds the lmfit 1.3.4 `conf_interval` calling convention. The issue did not include the original exception text. Direct reproduction against lmfit 1.3.4 confirms the likely failures:

- `lmfit.conf_interval(result)` → `TypeError: conf_interval() missing 1 required positional argument: 'result'`
- `lmfit.conf_interval(result.minimizer, result)` on a `ModelResult` → `AttributeError: 'ModelResult' object has no attribute 'minimizer'`
- `MinimizerResult.conf_interval()` → `AttributeError: 'MinimizerResult' object has no attribute 'conf_interval'`

The valid forms are `ModelResult.conf_interval(...)` and `lmfit.conf_interval(minimizer, result)`.

## Changes

- `skills/code-engineer/SKILL.md`: adds a version-sensitive API section before the workflow. It gives the two valid lmfit 1.3.4 calls, names the invalid forms, requires an `errorbars` check, and points to the reference before the first call. The output-handling guidance now asks for the installed version and the exact exception instead of a guessed correction.
- `skills/code-engineer/references/lmfit-confidence-intervals.md`: documents the result-type matrix, the exact observed errors, and the `errorbars` failure condition.
- `skills/code-engineer/references/lmfit_confidence_intervals.py`: runnable Michaelis-Menten example covering both fit paths.

No exception is swallowed, and no successful result is fabricated. The executor and runtime error handling are unchanged.

## Validation

Environment: Windows 11, Python 3.12.14, lmfit 1.3.4, numpy 2.2.6.

The reference example was run directly and through the bundled executor:

```text
lmfit version: 1.3.4
ModelResult vmax: 12.071
ModelResult vmax stderr: 0.091
ModelResult CI parameters: ['km', 'vmax']
MinimizerResult vmax: 12.071
MinimizerResult vmax stderr: 0.091
MinimizerResult CI parameters: ['km', 'vmax']
```

The invalid `lmfit.conf_interval(result)` path was also run through `skills/code-engineer/scripts/execute.py`. It still emits the real traceback and `TypeError`, with `Exit code: 1`, so the documented failure is not hidden.

## E2E user journeys

**BLOCKED.** The agent/`run_python` timeline and local stack require Linux or macOS per `CONTRIBUTING.md`; this session is Windows 11. I executed the library-level example and the bundled executor path, but not the full product journey. The original session's exception text was unavailable, so the reproduction covers the candidate calling conventions rather than the exact transcript.

Partial fix; keep #589 open until the first-call guidance is verified through the agent/`run_python` path on a supported host.

Refs #589

## Release

Release category: release:fix
GitHub label: pending a maintainer; this contributor account has no upstream write access.
User impact: the code-engineer skill now steers the first lmfit confidence-interval call to the correct 1.3.4 signature and requires checking `errorbars`; failed calls still surface the real exception.
Compatibility and migration: none.

pr:603.body:
Parallel research agents already share arXiv concurrency/pacing, but later calls could still queue behind a known upstream failure and repeated 406 responses had no endpoint-health suppression. This change shares health and cooldown within one service process, bounds admission and actual attempts, and permits one recovery probe after cooldown.

Fixes #208

## Behavior

- Preserve existing concurrency and request intervals. Governed calls make one MCP attempt, so internal retries cannot bypass pacing while holding a slot. Missing queue limits now default to 8 waiters / 20 seconds, capped by the tool timeout.
- Share 429 cooldown by upstream group and effective endpoint/authentication digest, honoring Retry-After in seconds or HTTP-date. Without a hint, backoff starts at 1 second and caps at 30 seconds. Reject affected waiters immediately and return retry timing instead of independent sleeps.
- Keep request-specific or unattributed 406 local. Three distinct, consecutive, provider-attributed endpoint refusals within one minute trigger source/tool suppression: 30-second initial cooldown, capped at 120 seconds. Repeated identical inputs do not reach the threshold.
- Admit one post-cooldown probe; success restores access, failure continues bounded suppression, and cancellation releases the slot and probe permit. Credential changes remain isolated; other sources continue working.
- Return a short unavailable/blocked explanation plus structured timing, same-kind alternative source IDs and citation/evidence guidance. Never claim an uncalled alternative or unavailable content was retrieved. Sanitize provider metadata and diagnostics. No distributed state, infrastructure or new user controls.

## Validation

Tested candidate: `ae5f87f0608a008e9ced844d848621071077b983`.

| Check | Planned | Executed | Passed | Failed / skipped |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Affected Node UT and deterministic broker/transport fault injection | 117 | 117 | 117 | 0 / 0 |
| Bundled Python MCP tests, including HTTP failure attribution and Retry-After | 30 | 30 | 30 | 0 / 0 |
| Production API user journey | 5 | 5 | 5 | 0 / 0 |

Commands: `pnpm build`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm docs:check`, `node scripts/check-architecture.mjs`, targeted `node --import tsx --test` for data-source, tool registry, public-biomed manifests and affected API MCP suites, and Python unittest discovery under `services/gateway/tests`.

Documentation validation: 172 files linted, 144 Markdown files link-checked. Static architecture boundaries: 297 package source files checked.

Baseline regression at `87a87dd36e404cdbc809761991e05e21aa911b8a`: after an injected 429, a later agent round returned a queue timeout without shared retry timing. The same regression passes with fail-fast shared cooldown and no additional upstream attempt.

An extra architecture-wrapper run passed 68/69 script tests; its unrelated RACE contract test could not initialize the default uv cache in the sandbox. The standalone architecture boundary checker passes. Full `ci:ut`, `ci:st` and mocked browser `ci:e2e` were not run: validation targets the changed backend and production API path. No real arXiv/PubMed, real models, DRB or Nightly evaluations were run.

## E2E user journeys

**PASS** — `node test/api/source-health-journey.mjs`, production API process and official SDK HTTP MCP fixtures; no in-process API replacement or model calls. Tested SHA: `ae5f87f0608a008e9ced844d848621071077b983`.

| User scenario | Expected | Actual |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Configure isolated sources and two research sessions | Real API startup and usable local sources | PASS |
| Concurrent 429 and a later agent round | Shared cooldown and bounded return without amplification | PASS: 9 user calls produced 1 MCP attempt; persisted audit includes retry timing |
| Failed recovery probe, then upstream recovery | One probe during continued failure; later real results | PASS: one failed probe, then two successful accesses |
| Request-specific versus persistent endpoint 406 | Request errors remain local; sustained rejection suppresses later calls | PASS: 4 request-specific failures remain callable; 3 distinct endpoint refusals trigger suppression; later round makes 0 attempts |
| Credentials and healthy source isolation | New credentials can attempt; original cooldown persists; healthy source works | PASS: isolated attempt, preserved original cooldown and real healthy-source result; no credentials in audit |

The journey asserts the short unavailable-source explanation and honest blocked feedback. Broker fault injection additionally verifies queue exhaustion/timeouts, cancellation, probe cancellation, recovery with changed failure status, continued source pacing, available scholarly fallback and unchanged citation/full-text evidence boundaries.

## Release

Release category: release:fix
User impact: Parallel research avoids repeated waits and calls to a known failing source; diagnostics distinguish throttling and endpoint refusal while preserving evidence requirements.
Compatibility and migration: No user migration. Internal broker queue defaults are now bounded; generic ResourceRateLimiter optional dimensions remain available. State is process-local and resets on restart.

`skills/report-writer/SKILL.md` contains 11 fenced-code markers (` ``` `):

| Line | Pair |
|------|------|
| 33 / 42 | paired |
| 48 / 60 | paired |
| 64 / 79 | paired |
| 87 / 89 | paired |
| 136 / 140 | paired |
| 225 | **unpaired** |

The "Default Report Template" block starting around `:182` was clearly meant to be fenced, but its opening marker is missing. The template body renders as live markdown inside the skill document, and `:225` leaves an open block.

**Reproduce:** `grep -nc '```' skills/report-writer/SKILL.md` returns 11 (odd).

**Why CI does not catch it:** `.markdownlint-cli2.jsonc` sets globs to `README.md`, `README_zh.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and `docs/**/*.md`. The `skills/**` directory is never linted, even though `pnpm docs:check` otherwise gates markdown quality.

**Suggested fix:** Close the fence at `:182` and add `skills/**/*.md` to the markdownlint globs.

# English version

## Positioning

ScienceDiscovery now has a [public website](https://sciencediscovery.github.io/) where visitors can learn about the research workspace, explore the home-page demo, and continue to the [installation page](https://sciencediscovery.github.io/install/index.html) and [documentation](https://sciencediscovery.github.io/docs/index.html). This issue expands on the website work mentioned in the [#213 Beta release-note draft](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/issues/213).

This is a request for community feedback on the website's content, navigation, and onboarding experience. It is not a formal software release announcement, and the demo does not establish that every depicted workflow has passed live validation.

## Draft website launch notes

### Home page: understand and explore

- **Product overview and entry points**: the home page introduces the ScienceDiscovery research workflow, a quick Linux installation path, core capabilities, and links to installation and documentation.
- **An interactive demo that starts on its own**: the HTML demo presents a workbench-like interface. When it comes into view, a scripted literature-review workflow plays once. Visitors can follow the task, tool calls, and artifacts without taking any action, much like watching a short video.
- **Hands-on exploration**: visitors can choose another scripted scenario, replay it, click nodes, switch views, and adjust chart or structure controls. The scenarios illustrate literature research, Idea Tree, Evolve, the memory graph, and scientific data visualizations.

The demo uses scripted flows and illustrative data to show product capabilities. It does not run a live research task against the product backend, and its charts and structures are not experimental results.

### Installation page: choose a path for your environment

The [installation page](https://sciencediscovery.github.io/install/index.html) organizes options by Linux, macOS, and Windows and explains the prerequisites and steps for prebuilt Linux binaries, Docker, and source mode. It provides release downloads and SHA256 checksums, post-start checks, and links to the full deployment guide. Some platform paths are marked experimental. Consult the page for current prerequisites.

### Documentation: go deeper

The [documentation](https://sciencediscovery.github.io/docs/index.html) offers English and Chinese entry points, navigation, and full-text site search. Readers can explore getting started, core capabilities, domain guides, advanced setup, reference material, and developer documentation. The website builds these pages from the [ScienceDiscovery repository's `docs/` directory](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/tree/main/docs). Documentation content is maintained upstream. The website provides its presentation and navigation.

## Version relationship and usage notes

The website documentation follows the product repository's `main` branch and may describe changes that are not part of a particular release. Download links on the installation page can also change as the site is updated. Check the [installation page](https://sciencediscovery.github.io/install/index.html) and [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/releases) for the versions available when you visit. For the behavior and limitations of a specific release, use its release notes and version-specific documentation.

## Community feedback

We welcome feedback on whether the home-page demo communicates the product clearly, which interactions or descriptions could be misleading, how easy it is to find an installation path and its prerequisites, and any gaps in documentation navigation, search, or English and Chinese content. For a page issue, please include its URL, browser, and steps to reproduce.

---

# 中文版

## 定位

ScienceDiscovery 现已提供[公开网站](https://sciencediscovery.github.io/)：访客可以先了解科研工作台、观看并操作首页演示，再前往[安装页](https://sciencediscovery.github.io/install/index.html) 和[文档页](https://sciencediscovery.github.io/docs/index.html)开始使用。这是软件的展示与入门入口，也是 [#213 Beta Release Note 草案](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/issues/213) 中提到的网站配套工作的详细说明。

本 issue 征求社区对网站内容、导航和入门体验的反馈，不是软件正式发布公告，也不代表演示中的每个流程都已通过实际运行验收。

## 网站说明草案

### 首页：从了解产品到动手探索

- **产品介绍与入口**：首页概述 ScienceDiscovery 的科研工作流程，提供 Linux 快速安装入口、核心能力介绍，以及安装和文档链接。
- **自动播放的交互演示**：首页中的 HTML 演示呈现工作台界面。当演示区域进入视野时，预设的文献调研流程会自动播放一次，即使访客不操作，也能像观看短片一样了解任务推进、工具调用和产物呈现。
- **由访客操作**：访客可以选择其他预设场景并观看相应流程，也可以重新播放，或在场景中点击节点、切换视图、调整图表与结构参数。场景涵盖文献调研、Idea Tree、Evolve、记忆图谱及科研数据可视化等。

演示使用预设脚本和示意数据来呈现产品能力，不是连接真实后端的在线科研任务，图表和结构也不是实验结果。

### 安装页：按环境选择路径

[安装页](https://sciencediscovery.github.io/install/index.html) 按 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 展示可选路径，分别说明预编译 Linux 二进制、Docker 和源码运行的适用条件与步骤。页面提供发行包下载及 SHA256 校验值、启动后的检查方式，并链接到更完整的部署指南。部分平台路径标为实验性，具体前置条件应以安装页为准。

### 文档页：深入使用与查阅

[文档页](https://sciencediscovery.github.io/docs/index.html) 提供中英文入口、目录导航与站内全文搜索，可继续阅读快速开始、核心能力、领域教程、进阶配置、参考资料和开发文档。这些内容由网站从 [ScienceDiscovery 主仓库的 `docs/` 目录](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/tree/main/docs) 构建而来，文档正文在主仓库维护；网站仓库负责呈现和导航。

## 版本关系与使用提示

网站文档跟随主仓库 `main` 更新，因此可能描述尚未进入某个已发布版本的内容。安装页的下载入口也会随网站维护而变化，请以访问时的[安装页](https://sciencediscovery.github.io/install/index.html) 和 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/releases) 确认可下载版本。特定版本的行为与限制，以对应的发行说明和版本文档为准。

## 社区反馈

欢迎反馈：首页演示是否清楚地传达产品能力、哪些交互或说明容易造成误解、安装路径与前置条件是否容易找到，以及文档导航、搜索或中英文内容有哪些不足。如反馈页面问题，请附页面链接、浏览器和复现步骤。
